title: tc-handoff
description: The agent hands control to a person mid-task with what it did, why it stopped and what it needs – and takes it back.

ask.description: What it needs you to do, lower case after "needs you to", e.g. "sign in to Stripe"

task.description: The run it belongs to, e.g. "Book flights to Lisbon" – shown under the heading

step.description: Where in the run, e.g. "Step 4 of 7"

blocker.description: Why it stopped, in a pill: "Sign-in required", "Needs a decision"

reason.description: The agent's own words on why it stopped

needs.description: What it needs from you – a checklist once you have control

checked.description: Ids of the needs ticked off

note.description: Your note for the agent, passed on when you hand back

doneTitle.description: Heading of the list of what the agent did

needsTitle.description: Heading of the list of what the agent needs – the checklist once you have control

noteLabel.description: Label of the note field shown while you have control

shortcuts.description: Show ⌘↵ hints on the main button (the shortcut works either way). Default true

meta.description: Right-aligned and quiet, e.g. "3 results" or "0:42"
